catalogueIntro: Explore evidence-informed information about two weight-management medicines. This is not a recommendation or offer to supply.
dashboardNextBody: Read treatment information and follow your requests in one place.
semaglutideShort: A GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for long-term weight management alongside lifestyle support.
tirzepatideShort: A GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for long-term weight management alongside lifestyle support.
pricesIntro: These are administrator-managed illustrative references, not a quote or offer. They do not establish suitability or access to medicine.
doseScheduleIntro: An illustrative escalation example paired with the current reference price tier.
tirzepatideSharedTier: The 12.5 mg and 15 mg example stages both use the configured month-5+ price tier. That tier is not a dose-specific price or a rule to increase dose.
doseScheduleCaution: This is a general illustration, not your dose schedule. A qualified prescriber must decide whether a medicine, dose or change is appropriate; progression may be delayed, different or not occur.
priceScope: These references cover the treatment amount only. Delivery, prescribing, consultation and other services are not included unless separately confirmed. Actual arrangements and prices may differ.
conceptImage: Concept illustration only — not evidence of an actual supplied product, its packaging or its quality.
semaglutideHow: Semaglutide acts on GLP-1 receptors involved in appetite and food intake. It is used under an appropriate prescribing and monitoring process.
tirzepatideHow: Tirzepatide acts on both GIP and GLP-1 receptors involved in appetite and food intake. It is used under an appropriate prescribing and monitoring process.
semaglutideEvidence: Trials in studied adult populations found meaningful average weight reduction alongside lifestyle support. Individual responses vary, and trial averages do not predict your result.
tirzepatideEvidence: Trials found meaningful average weight reduction alongside lifestyle support. In one head-to-head trial of adults with obesity without diabetes, average reduction exceeded semaglutide; this does not determine individual suitability.
precautionsBody: Nausea, vomiting and digestive effects are common. Serious adverse effects can occur. Pregnancy plans, existing conditions and other medicines require independent professional assessment. Seek urgent medical advice for severe persistent abdominal pain.
storageBody: Storage depends on the exact licensed formulation and pack supplied. Follow its current official leaflet and pharmacist's instructions; do not infer storage life from these concept images. No product-specific laboratory certificate is available here.
requestIntro: Share contact details so the administrator can review your request. This is not a purchase, prescription or approval to receive medicine.
